regime = (Y > np.median(Y)).astype(int)
cond_means = [X[regime==r].mean() for r in (0,1)]
cond_vars = [X[regime==r].var() for r in (0,1)]

total_var = np.mean(cond_vars) + np.var(cond_means)
caption: Law of total variance: within-regime risk plus between-regime risk.
